The '''Debug Rom''' is a prototype build of Ocarina of Time: Master Quest. It's release has brought about an incredible wealth of knowledge to the Ocarina of Time modding community. [https://tcrf.net/index.php?title=Proto:The_Legend_of_Zelda:_Ocarina_of_Time_Master_Quest The Cutting Room Floor] contains a lot of information on different features of the Debug Rom.

== Emulating the Debug Rom ==

===Project64===
<ol>
<li> Load the rom in Project 64</li>
<li> When it starts to run, Go to Options -> Settings -> ROM Settings </li>
<li> Set the following:<br>
{|class="wikitable"
!CPU CORE STYLE
|RECOMPILER
|-
!SELF-MODIFYING CODE METHOD
|CHECK MEMORY ADVANCE
|-
!MEMORY SIZE
|8MB
|-
!ADVANCED BLOCK LINKING
|DEFAULT
|-
!DEFAULT SAVE TYPE
|USE FIRST USED
|-
!COUNTER FACTOR
|2
|-
!LARGE COMPILE BUFFER
|NO
|-
!USE TLB
|NO
|-
!REGISTER CACHING
|YES
|-
!DELAY SI INTERRUPT
|NO
|-
!SP HACK
|NO
|-
!RSP AUDIO SIGNAL
|NO
|}
</li>
<li>After all this is done, reset the game, if it does not show up, press generate bitmap, then reset the game again.</li>
<li>IF done correctly, you should see the correct graphics, if not see, Trouble with Video. If you do not have any sound, see Trouble with Sound</li>
</ol>

===Nemu===
# Set memory size to 8MB
# Use any other plugin than the default

There are probably more steps involved.

===Wii64===
# Set expansion pack to 8 mb if not by default
# Set Framebuffer textures on
# If you have v1.2 use rice video to avoid texture mapping and z-buffer glitches.
# If rom crashes after the second load screen or doesn't stop loading after 35 seconds, recopy the rom to the /wii64/roms/ directory on your SD card

===Troubleshooting===
Q: I don't see any video but I hear sound!<br>
A: Change your plugin.

Q: During game, I hear some sorta annoying sound that keeps popping up<br>
A: Go to Sound Options -> Sync Sound to game (or w/e)

Q: I don't hear sound but I have video!<br>
A: Try switching your sound options around
